title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LinkConnectivityServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LinkConnectivityServiceOffering. Link-level connectivity service offering (no formal definition provided by the source ontology beyond its class hierarchy position). Subclass of ConnectivityServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ConnectivityServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LinkConnectivityServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

protocolType.description: Property. Link protocol type. Controlled-vocabulary value (ProtocolType), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

vlanConfiguration.description: Relationship. VLAN configuration. Links to a VLANConfiguration entity.
